purpose: CAL experiment B1: the +-NDEBUG RCCL A/B. Same source tree, one line apart, both measured on the atomics-enabled box.
host: VM 101, the VFIO guest, RX 7900 XT pair, TP=2

source.upstream: ROCm/rccl release/rocm-rel-7.1.1.1, --depth 1, so no .git and no commit to quote

configure.note: -DROCM_PATH was not needed by the 2026-07 build; the CMake variable defaults to /opt/rocm, which does not exist in this wheel-SDK image, so CMakeLists.txt:191 died reading /opt/rocm/.info/version. Why it resolved in July and not now is not established.

post_build: both arms took the identical patchelf treatment build-rccl-nohostcall.sh applies: --remove-needed librocm_smi64.so.1, --add-needed librsmi_stub.so.1. Their NEEDED lists are identical.

measurement.sweeps: three per arm, INTERLEAVED A B A B A B; the library is reinstalled and md5-asserted before each
measurement.script: b1/allreduce.py, md5 4503492023cb2dcb845c1843730fa0da -- benchmarks/allreduce-2026-09-02/allreduce.py with the hostcall detector fixed; the 09-02 campaign's own copy was left untouched
measurement.round1: one sweep per arm, ar-*.jsonl, kept. Its ar_meta records hostcall 0 for BOTH arms: a false negative from the CCOB-compressed fatbin, which is what prompted the detector fix and round 2.
